description: Block dangerous terminal commands — DROP TABLE, DELETE FROM without WHERE, destructive migrations

PreToolUse.command: node -e "const p=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8')); const cmd=(p.toolUse?.input?.command||'').toUpperCase(); const blocked=['DROP TABLE','DROP DATABASE','TRUNCATE TABLE','DELETE FROM']; const found=blocked.find(b=>cmd.includes(b)); if(found){console.log(JSON.stringify({decision:'deny',reason:'Blocked destructive command: '+found+'. TeamReel rule: NEVER DROP TABLES.'}));} else {console.log(JSON.stringify({decision:'allow'}));}"

windows.command: node -e "const p=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8')); const cmd=(p.toolUse?.input?.command||'').toUpperCase(); const blocked=['DROP TABLE','DROP DATABASE','TRUNCATE TABLE','DELETE FROM']; const found=blocked.find(b=>cmd.includes(b)); if(found){console.log(JSON.stringify({decision:'deny',reason:'Blocked destructive command: '+found+'. TeamReel rule: NEVER DROP TABLES.'}));} else {console.log(JSON.stringify({decision:'allow'}));}"
